[vioscsi] BZ#1539256: vioscsi to support ACK of VIRTIO_F_IOMMU_PLATFORM

Background: https://issues.oasis-open.org/browse/VIRTIO-154

According to MS documentation to ensure the usage of IOMMU DMA memory API
should be used. vioscsi driver already uses DMA API for memory allocation
related to data transfer. VIRTIO_F_IOMMU_PLATFORM will be enabled for
Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016

netkvm: BZ#1351089: Don't set MAC address using configuration space in
virtio 1.0 device

In virtio 1.0 MAC address in virtio configuration space is read-only. For
virtio 1.0 device, If VIRTIO_NET_F_CTRL_MAC_ADDR flag is disabled (setting
MAC address using control queue), the driver shouldn't attempt to use
configuration space to set MAC address.

Signed-off-by: Yan Vugenfirer <yvugenfi@redhat.com>

netkvm: BZ#1351089: Control queue should be acked before MAC address
configuration is attempted

VIRTIO_NET_F_CTRL_MAC_ADDR feature depends on control queue availability.
Before the fix control queue was acked after MAC address was initialized.
The behaviour caused the driver to always use MAC configuration through
virtio configuration space (VIRTIO_NET_F_MAC).

Signed-off-by: Yan Vugenfirer <yvugenfi@redhat.com>

netkvm: BZ#1351089: DumpMac to print caller function name

netkvm: driver should fail initialization if PCI resources init failed

This bug caused by historical refactoring done in
ParaNdis_InitializeContext function. If PCI resource initialization failed
driver should not continue execution of ParaNdis_InitializeContext
function.

Always ACK RSC related virtio features if RSC is supported

The driver will always acknowledge the features and will disable RSC if
needed using control queue message.

Such behaviour is needed to ensure that extended virtio-net headed size
will be used if host and driver are ready to support QEMU RSC.
